AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.description: A brief introduction to who I am.

resume.paragraph_1: I'm Muhammad Nandha Chrismawan, a Software Developer based in Surabaya, Indonesia. I graduated from the D4 Informatics Engineering program at Politeknik Elektronika Negeri Surabaya (PENS) on July 24, 2026.
resume.paragraph_2: During frontend internships at PT. Mitra Informatika and PT. Piramida Teknologi Informasi, I worked on authentication UX, design tokens, browser media, typed API integration, and real-time web interfaces. My responsibilities were distinct from teammates' backend, mobile, and communication-protocol work.
resume.paragraph_3: As a freelance frontend developer for Spectra, I built participant and administrator interfaces for a deployed assessment platform used at two annual events. For my individual final project, I developed a modular fleet-management frontend with federated development, a single production host bundle, shared API boundaries, and limited-connectivity PWA support.
resume.paragraph_4: These projects shaped my interest in application structure, data flow, and explicit integration boundaries. I'm looking to contribute to web and Software Developering teams while continuing to deepen those skills.
